text: trend_signals: the main analytical table. One row per competitor SKU, self-catalog SKU, or Instagram (category, style_tag) cluster - 20 columns, PRIMARY KEY (source, source_id). Contains momentum, percent change, weekly metric values, price, and stock status. Use this table for any question about trends, momentum, velocity, price, or stock levels - it is the default table for almost every query.

competitor_pdp: pass-through table holding the full original competitor product record as a JSON blob in the data column, keyed by competitor SKU (id column). Also has category and style_tag columns pulled out for direct filtering. Use this table only when you need product detail not present in trend_signals - brand name, title, bullet description.

self_catalog: pass-through table holding the full original self-catalog product record as a JSON blob in the data column, keyed by SKU (id column). Also has category and style_tag columns pulled out for direct filtering. Use this table only when you need product detail not present in trend_signals - style name, title, launch date.

ig_posts: pass-through table holding the full original Instagram post record as a JSON blob in the data column, keyed by post_id (id column). Also has category and style_tag columns pulled out for direct filtering. Use this table only when you need post detail not present in trend_signals - caption text, hashtags, influencer handle, likes, comments.
